instruction: Please help disable the 'Show tips on startup' option in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the tips on startup option via Edit > Preferences > Help System. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (show-tips no) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable 'Show tips on startup' in GIMP
Postconfig correctly closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure config changes are written to disk - this is critical for GIMP config verification
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses the gimprc file and checks for 'show-tips no' setting
Parameter handling is correct: when expected.type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'] directly, and the metric receives this as the 'rule' parameter
The metric correctly accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] to check the config setting
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks all requirements in the instruction (disabling tips on startup)
Logic handles edge cases: checks for None config_path, skips comments and empty lines in config file parsing
